title: Business Development Representative (French speaking)
description:
Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work.
 Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.
 We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.
 We sell a powerful, flexible product to organizations with very different problems, teams, and ways of working. That means the best opportunities rarely come from following a script. We need someone who finds that energising—someone curious enough to understand how a business works, persistent enough to earn a prospect’s attention, and thoughtful enough to make every interaction relevant.
 If you’re excited by the challenge of finding the right accounts, understanding what matters to them, and figuring out how to earn a conversation, you’ll thrive here. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn quickly from what works and what doesn’t, and build the skills to become an exceptional salesperson.
 Please note, this is a hybrid position based in the London office with the expectation of 3 days a week in office (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday).
 What you'll do
 Run a hybrid pipeline motion: act on product-led signals early in the week, then shift into outbound prospecting for the bulk of your time.
 Qualify prospects through calls, emails, and social media (LinkedIn) to generate sales-ready meetings for Account Executives.
 Partner with AEs on our larger, more strategic accounts, shaping territory plans and outreach.
 Build, test, and i…

title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
description:
The role

HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.

As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team, you own what makes that vision real and felt. You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me.

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.

What you’ll do

  • Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.
  • The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.
  • Cross-Org Data Supplier: You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer, Intelligent Platforms (all genders)
description:
About the role

At HelloFresh, data is at the heart of everything we do — from the moment a customer places an order to the way we forecast demand, optimize our supply chain, and personalize experiences for millions of people. Making that data fast, reliable, and available is what our Data Platform makes possible.

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join our Operational Data Platform team — the squad that ensures operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with the quality guarantees that everything downstream depends on — so the analytics layer receives quality data, ready to be turned into governed assets. You will build the streaming, messaging, and self-service provisioning systems that hundreds of backend and data engineers rely on every day.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of our platform. You'll own critical infrastructure, drive efficiency, and help define the "golden path" that makes it effortless for engineers across the company to store and stream their data — with governance and cost control built in from the start.

What you'll do

  • Build and run our streaming and messaging platform. Own the systems that move data in real time and at scale — Kafka, Kafka Connect, Flink, and SQS — and keep them fast, resilient, and easy to build on.
  • Drive efficiency. Identify and act on opportunities to reduce the cost and complexity of the platform, and make efficiency a default rather than an afterthought.
  • Own the reliability of critical data paths. Keep the systems at the heart of the platform highly available, and continuously improve their resilience, observability, and operational maturity.

title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner ! 

Notre ambition ?  Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

L'opportunité:

HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients.
